node.title: Transferencia de contexto
node.summary: Transfer evidence with meaning, limits and conditions for its receiving decision.

relations: The Japan case offers an organizational comparison for context-preserving handoffs between distinct decision owners.
La supervisión de una empresa y una interfaz entre agentes independientes no son equivalentes. El vocabulario EA sería una interpretación posterior.
The supplier case shows why evidence handoff needs the decision context that makes a document meaningful.
Un PDF con metadatos no satisface automáticamente EHD. La comparación no identifica compliance de proveedor con confianza de agentes.
Materialized context and epistemic handoff share a need for explicit validity conditions, although they represent different objects.
Un vector de factores no es un descriptor epistemológico ni resuelve composición entre autoridades. La equivalencia se limita a dependencia contextual explícita.
Architectural translation could preserve not only interface fields but also their meaning, authority and validity conditions at each receiving operation.
Es una aplicación propuesta del handoff; el proyecto industrial no se presenta como implementación de Ecosystem Awareness.
Shared mission accountability does not erase the distinct authority conditions that must accompany a handoff between operational owners.
La comparación no convierte una red de especialistas en una implementación del protocolo de handoff EA.
Cross-border operational handoffs should preserve the responsible entity, jurisdiction and delegated scope rather than treating continuity as uniform authority.
No se infiere equivalencia regulatoria ni una personalidad jurídica estadounidense independiente.
The contracting vehicle, decision owner and execution platform remain distinct even when they participate in the same operational handoff.
Un marco técnico de transferencia no sustituye documentos societarios, contratos ni verificación fiscal.
Voluntary cooperation can preserve each participant's knowledge limits and decision rights while making shared action more intelligible.
La tesis social y el contrato técnico EA tienen niveles distintos; el segundo no demuestra toda la primera.
A cross-operator assignment should carry the context and acceptance conditions that allow each responsible operator to authorize its own action.
Es una extensión de diseño que debe contrastarse con contratos e interfaces reales; no una función general ya validada.
The early distributed-team lineage explains why cross-border work required information discipline and operational continuity long before remote work became a workplace category.
Las dos fuentes pertenecen a un mismo linaje narrativo; no son testimonios independientes del mismo hecho.
A generative boundary can inspire an interface design that shares enough context for safe coordination without requiring both sides to adopt an identical internal model.
La metáfora social no demuestra equivalencia formal con la arquitectura EA ni su suficiencia técnica.
Cross-border legitimacy can support knowledge transfer, but the receiving operation still needs explicit roles, technical readiness and acceptance conditions.
Analogía entre función social y caso industrial; confianza no reemplaza permisos, seguridad ni aceptación de calidad.
Typed meaning transfer offers a possible technical comparison for a generative boundary: sufficient shared meaning for a defined question without forcing identical internal models.
La analogía social no es una demostración de equivalencia matemática ni concede derechos sobre información ajena.
Selective, source-qualified handoffs could let one field fact support several receivers without exposing unnecessary information or substituting one receiver’s determination for another’s.
Propuesta posterior al caso; no se atribuye al sistema histórico la implementación del protocolo de señalización.
A technical analogy is partial, question-preserving meaning transfer: coordination can require enough shared interpretation without identical internal ontologies.
La afinidad no demuestra que la institución funcione como el modelo matemático ni que la tipología social derive de él.
